# Launch plan: billing v2

<Summary>Ship **this Thursday** unless the load test fails. Vote on the day below.</Summary>

<Stats>
  <Stat label="Beta signups" value="1,284" delta="+18%" />
  <Stat label="Open bugs" value="7" delta="-5" invert />
  <Stat label="p95 checkout" value="420ms" delta="-12%" invert />
</Stats>

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  Freeze[Code freeze] --> Load[Load test] --> Ship
  Load -- fails --> Fix[Fix and retest] --> Load
```

<Chart type="area" data="signups.json" x="week" y="signups" height={200} />

## Decide

<Poll id="day" question="When do we launch?" options={["This Thursday", "Next Thursday"]} />

<Approval id="go" title="Go for launch" description="Sign off once your part is ready." approvers={["priya.shah@example.com", "marcus.lee@example.com", "tom.okafor@example.com"]} />

<Checklist id="launch" items={["Docs", "Status page", "Announcement email"]} />

<Comments />

label: Retro board
title: Sprint 42 retro
blurb: A React app in one file: cards and votes sync live between everyone with the page open.
html: import { useState } from "react"; import { Avatar, Input } from "@a/ui"; import { useSharedMap, useViewer } from "@a/hooks"; import { ThumbsUp } from "lucide-react"; type Card = { col: string; text: string; by: string | null }; const COLUMNS = ["Went well", "To improve", "Actions"]; export default function Retro() { const cards = useSharedMap<Card>("card"); const votes = useSharedMap<boolean>("vote"); // vote/<card>/<email> const { email, canWrite } = useViewer(); const [drafts, setDrafts] = useState<Record<string, string>>({}); const count = (id: string) => votes.entries.filter(([k]) => k.startsWith(`${id}/`)).length; const mine = (id: string) => votes.get(`${id}/${email}`); function add(col: string) { const text = drafts[col]?.trim(); if (!text || !canWrite) return; cards.set(crypto.randomUUID(), { col, text, by: email }); setDrafts({ ...drafts, [col]: "" }); } function vote(id: string) { const key = `${id}/${email}`; mine(id) ? votes.delete(key) : votes.set(key, true); } return ( <div className="grid min-h-full content-start gap-4 px-5 pt-5 pb-20 sm:grid-cols-3"> {COLUMNS.map((col) => ( <section key={col} className="flex flex-col gap-2"> <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold text-muted-foreground">{col}</h2> {cards.entries .filter(([, c]) => c.col === col) .sort((a, b) => count(b[0]) - count(a[0])) .map(([id, c]) => ( <div key={id} className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg border border-border bg-card p-3 text-sm"> <Avatar email={c.by ?? undefined} size="sm" /> <span className="flex-1">{c.text}</span> <button className={`flex items-center gap-1 text-xs ${mine(id) ? "text-primary" : "text-muted-foreground"}`} disabled={!canWrite} onClick={() => vote(id)} > <ThumbsUp className="size-3.5" /> {count(id)} </button> </div> ))} <Input placeholder="Add a card…" value={drafts[col] ?? ""} disabled={!canWrite} onChange={(e) => setDrafts({ ...drafts, [col]: e.target.value })} onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === "Enter" && add(col)} /> </section> ))} </div> ); }

value.text: Billing beta shipped a day early
Flaky e2e tests blocked two merges

label: Cost report
title: Cloud costs: September
blurb: A report from data files: sortable table, stacked chart, a budget form and shared notes.
source:
# Cloud costs: September

<Summary>Spend fell **14%** to $18.2k after CI moved to spot instances.</Summary>

<Stats>
  <Stat label="Total" value="$18.2k" delta="-14%" invert />
  <Stat label="Compute" value="$11.0k" delta="-22%" invert />
  <Stat label="Storage" value="$4.1k" delta="+6%" invert />
</Stats>

<Chart type="bar" data="monthly.json" x="month" y="compute storage network" stacked height={220} />

<Table
  data="services.json"
  columns={["service", "team", { key: "cost", format: "currency" }, { key: "change", format: "percent" }]}
  sort="-cost"
  search
/>

<Callout tone="warning" title="Storage keeps growing">
  Logs are kept for 90 days. Keeping 30 would save about $900 a month.
</Callout>

## October budgets

<Form
  id="budget"
  title="Your team's October budget"
  description="One answer per team lead. You can change yours until the 25th."
  fields={[
    { name: "team", label: "Team", type: "select", options: ["Platform", "Search", "Data", "Web"], required: true },
    { name: "budget", label: "Budget ($)", type: "number", required: true },
    { name: "logs", label: "Cut log retention to 30 days", type: "checkbox" },
  ]}
/>

<Notes id="followups" placeholder="Follow-ups for next month…" rows={3} />
